set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set system login class [parameter1].explanation: This Junos command fragment defines a login class named `[parameter1]`, specifying permissions and access levels for users assigned to this class.

parameters.name: class-name
parameters.explanation: The name of the login class.

parameters.name: permissions
parameters.explanation: Assigns permission to login classes.

parameters.name: username
parameters.explanation: User name.

class [parameter2].explanation: Configure the type of system login user.

set system services [parameter1].explanation: Enable system services such as SSH.

parameters.name: service
parameters.explanation: System service name, e.g. ssh.

set routing-instances [parameter1].explanation: This command fragment configures a routing instance named `[parameter1]` in Junos, allowing for separate routing tables and protocols within that instance.

parameters.name: routing-instance
parameters.explanation: Name of route example, e.g. net.

parameters.name: policy-statement

term [parameter2].explanation: This command fragment configures a routing policy by defining a term within a policy statement, where `[parameter1]` is the policy name and `[parameter2]` is the term name.
